name: documint
description: Generate source-grounded Markdown and HTML documentation locally with no AI, or enhance it with OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, and custom OpenAI-compatible providers inside VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Generate enhanced documentation with the selected AI provider.
Generate deterministic documentation locally without an AI provider or API key.
documint.generationMode.description: Documentation generation mode. AI preserves the provider-backed workflow; Local runs entirely on-device from source analysis.

documint.aiProvider.description: AI mode only: provider for documentation generation. Ollama and LM Studio are local loopback presets and do not require an API key.
enumDescriptions: Local LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server at 127.0.0.1:1234.

documint.model.description: AI mode only: model to use for documentation generation. Ollama and LM Studio model IDs are discovered from their fixed local /v1/models endpoint when available; manual model IDs remain supported.

documint.documentationDepth.description: AI mode only: controls the depth of provider-generated documentation. Local mode is deterministic and does not use this setting.

documint.outputFormat.description: Documentation files to generate. Applies to both AI and Local modes.

documint.targetLanguages.description: Languages and source-file types included in workspace/folder scanning. Applies to both AI and Local modes.

documint.maxTokens.description: AI mode only: maximum output tokens requested per provider response. Provider and context-window safety limits can reduce this further.

documint.temperature.description: AI mode only: provider sampling temperature.

documint.rateLimitDelay.description: AI mode only: delay between provider API request starts in milliseconds.

documint.concurrentRequests.description: AI mode only: maximum number of detailed file documentation requests to run at the same time. Defaults to 5 for broader provider compatibility; increase it only when your provider rate limits allow.

documint.excludePatterns.description: Additional source-scan exclusions used by both AI and Local modes.

documint.customApiEndpoint.description: AI mode only: custom OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL, for example https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions
